Use the provided Riven reference for visual continuity.

Use Riven's weapon exactly as shown in the provided reference.
Do not redesign or alter the weapon.

Use the provided Burning Settlement reference
for the environment.

Use the provided Mysterious Dark Figure reference
for the dark figure.

Maintain the same burning settlement:
wooden buildings on fire,
heavy smoke,
orange firelight,
ash and embers drifting through the air.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Fast, physical, readable combat.

Strong realistic impact and body weight.

Dynamic but controlled cinematic camera movement.

Natural fire, footsteps, weapon impacts,
heavy breathing, wood breaking,
wind, and environmental sound.

No dialogue.

No subtitles.

No background music.

Keep Riven's weapon exactly consistent
with the provided reference.

Use only THREE major cinematic shots.


=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

The fight continues.

Riven is still standing,
but the Mysterious Dark Figure
begins moving much faster than before.

Riven can defend against the first attack,
but she gradually loses track of its movement.

The figure attacks from different directions
and forces Riven completely onto the defensive.

Riven attempts to fight back,
but the figure avoids her counterattack.

Then it rushes toward her again
with overwhelming speed and force.

Riven tries to defend herself.

The impact sends her violently
through part of a nearby burning wooden wall.

Riven falls inside the damaged building.

Through the broken opening,
the Mysterious Dark Figure slowly approaches.

CUT.


=== SHOT 1 — TOO FAST ===

Open on a new medium angle of Riven.

Do not repeat the exact ending composition
from the previous scene.

Riven is breathing heavily,
but she remains focused
and ready to fight.

The Mysterious Dark Figure stands ahead
within the drifting smoke.


Suddenly—

the figure moves.

Its dark body rushes sideways
with unnatural speed,
almost like a dark blur moving through the smoke.

Riven immediately turns to follow it.


The figure suddenly changes direction
and attacks.

Riven reacts in time.

She raises her weapon—

BLOCK.


A strong impact pushes Riven backward.

She remains on her feet.


But before Riven can counter,

the figure has already moved away again.


Riven quickly turns,
trying to follow its position.

The figure is becoming
too fast for her to track comfortably.


=== SHOT 2 — OUTMATCHED ===

The Mysterious Dark Figure attacks again.

Keep the exchange short,
fast,
and easy to understand.


The figure rushes toward Riven.

Riven avoids the attack.


It immediately changes direction.

Riven turns and blocks another strike.


Then the figure moves again—

faster.


This time,
Riven reacts slightly too late.


A powerful impact throws her sideways.


Riven hits the ground hard
but quickly pushes herself back up.

She is shaken,
but still fighting.


The dark figure appears ahead again.


Riven refuses to remain defensive.

She moves forward
and delivers a strong counterattack.


But just before her weapon connects—

the figure rapidly slips away
through the smoke.


Riven's attack misses.


She turns immediately,
trying to locate it again.


The fight is no longer under her control.


=== SHOT 3 — OVERWHELMED ===

Riven turns—

but the Mysterious Dark Figure
is already moving toward her.


A sudden DARK RUSH
surges directly through the smoke.


Riven barely has enough time to react.


She raises her weapon defensively
with both hands.


HEAVY IMPACT.


The force overwhelms her defense.


Riven is launched backward
toward a nearby burning wooden building.


She crashes through
a weakened section of the wooden wall.


Wood breaks apart.

Dust and smoke burst inward.


Keep the impact physical and grounded.

Do not make Riven fly an unrealistic distance.


CUT inside the damaged building.


Riven falls forward into
broken wood and debris.

She lands hard among the wreckage.


For a brief moment,
she remains down.


Then Riven moves.

She is hurt and disoriented,
but conscious.


She plants one hand against the ground
and begins trying to push herself up.


Keep Riven's weapon
visually consistent with the provided reference.


Behind her is the large opening
created by the impact.


Through that broken opening—

only fire and smoke are visible at first.


Riven slowly looks up.


Then—

within the smoke outside,

the Mysterious Dark Figure
gradually becomes visible.


It does not rush anymore.


It slowly advances
toward the broken opening.


Its dark silhouette remains partially obscured
by smoke and orange firelight.

No clear face.

No glowing eyes.

No dialogue.


Riven watches it approaching
while trying to recover.


Hold the tension.


CUT.


=== END STATE ===

Riven has been overwhelmed
by the Mysterious Dark Figure's speed and power.

She has been thrown through
part of a burning wooden building.

Riven is conscious
but shaken inside the debris.

Her weapon remains visually consistent
with the provided reference.

The Mysterious Dark Figure
is slowly approaching through the broken wall.

The fight is not over.

CUT.、16:9
